newsitem.title: USA: Foster Wheeler unit gets $174.4 million contract.
newsitem.headline: Foster Wheeler unit gets $174.4 million contract.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Energy International Inc. said Friday that a subsidiary won a $174.4 million contract to supply equipment for a Chinese power plant.
The contract is between its Foster Wheeler Energy Corp. subsidiary and Hebei Electric Power Corp., which is part of a joint venture operating the plant.
The plant will be located in Yijing, a town near Handan City in Hebei Province.
Foster Wheeler's stock fell 25 cents to $34.75 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
